fingerprintConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 sorted-key compact JSON containing id=null plus the complete goalTemplateWithoutId; not the native registry fingerprint
decisionScope: Advisory semantic suitability of the supplied-model explanation; conditional recommendations for the two draft child semantics.
semanticReasons: The requested competence is causal explanation from correct supplied models, not hard retrieval of compact facts.
The chromosome/chromatid and homologous-pair vocabulary is explicitly supplied; naming mechanisms from memory is not the success criterion.
Flashcards naming assortment or crossing-over would not establish either model explanation.
The same outcome should be assessed through explanation and model contrasts, not by an SRS completion marker.
conditions: Keep the supplied-model and supplied-terminology boundary in the final descriptions and evidence requirements.
If a later revision introduces indispensable unaided recall, perform a new semantic memory review.
Ordinary adopted atomic goals must exist before native goal-level memory decisions are written.
After any adoption, bind decisions to concrete canonical IDs and the actual registry fingerprint convention.
ruleApplied: AGENTS.md section 7.2: no_memory_needed is conservative; cards require compact indispensable recall; ordinary goals must exist first.
